svg.aria-label: The decision map: the same score-against-footprint data as Figure 1, reduced to the mean of the three axes, with the 15 GiB budget drawn as a wall and two stated thresholds across — 0.78, the competitive line, and 0.85, the top of the class. The three rings are the shortlist: the mean pick clover-35b-a3b-iq2 (AR mode only, section 13), the value pick g4-12b-qat at roughly half its footprint, and the budget pick g4-e4b-qat below the line because it costs 5.4 GiB. They are deliberately not the three highest dots. Both lines are stated thresholds, not statistics: six models clear 0.79 (0.876, 0.860, 0.824, 0.799, 0.799, 0.797), two clear 0.85, and at 0.75 ten do. There is no median crosshair and no upper-right "leader" corner, because here smaller footprint and higher score are both good, which a quadrant cannot express

The three rings are the shortlist: the mean pick clover-35b-a3b-iq2 (AR mode only, section 13), the value pick g4-12b-qat at roughly half its footprint, and the budget pick g4-e4b-qat below the line because it costs 5.4 GiB.
